nodes.text: then, a fugitive, in the lands through which the Adour bursts out
and the fury of the Tarbellian ocean roars,
fearing the weapons of a fortune long on the rampage,
you were bound by a match with poor Aemilia.
Soon slender money, sought with great effort,
brought comfort to you in your weariness, but not wealth as well.
You, the numbers of the sky and the stars that are privy to fate,
understood well, pursuing the study in secret;
nor was the pattern of my life, too, unknown to you,
which you had laid away in sealed tablets,
never disclosed; but my mother’s care uncovered
what the anxious care of a fearful grandfather kept hidden.
You, when you had drawn out your life for nine times ten years,
having felt the weapons, to be dreaded, of the goddess Fors,
